item.title: CVE-2026-90461 · 6.3 MEDIUM
item.description: OpenStack Ironic through 38.0.0 may send a username and password to an unexpected remote host when Image Service is configured for HTTP(S) Basic Authentication.

item.title: CVE-2026-90460 · 7.6 HIGH
item.description: An issue was discovered in OpenStack Keystone before 29.0.3. Tokens obtained via delegated authentication methods (EC2 credentials, application credentials, OAuth1 access tokens, and trusts) are not blocked from creating, modifying, or deleting crede…

item.title: CVE-2026-89169 · 4.1 MEDIUM
item.description: live-boot ff8867c allows attackers to bypass the dm-verity-enforce-roothash-signature protection mechanism when the .verity file is missing.

item.title: CVE-2026-89162 · 2.9 LOW
item.description: In PCRE2 before 10.48, pcre2_serialize_encode might disclose two bytes to an adversary, typically in a situation where the access available to the adversary is already unsafe.

item.title: CVE-2026-89161 · 7.4 HIGH
item.description: In PCRE2 before 10.48, pcre2_jit_match mishandles a previously copied subject being passed in as a context. An incorrect free operation can occur.

item.title: CVE-2026-89160 · 3.7 LOW 🌩️
item.description: PCRE2 before 10.48 has a pcre2_match out-of-bounds read during the PCRE2_MATCH_INVALID_UTF matching of an invalid UTF subject.

item.title: CVE-2026-89158 · 6.5 MEDIUM 🌩️
item.description: PCRE2 before 10.48, on 32-bit platforms, has a pcre2_compile_32 integer overflow and resultant out-of-bounds write.

item.title: CVE-2026-89157 · 5.7 MEDIUM
item.description: PCRE2 before 10.48, on 32-bit platforms, has a pcre2_pattern_convert out-of-bounds write when an attacker can provide a large pattern.

item.title: CVE-2026-89156 · 2.9 LOW
item.description: PCRE2 before 10.48 has a pcre2_match out-of-bounds read after a JIT fallback when an attacker can provide invalid UTF data.

item.title: CVE-2026-89151 · 3.5 LOW
